race.comment: ETERNAL TORMENT (1) brings the most appealing profile after a debut third at Nowra, beaten half a length by Adaptation despite interference around the home turn and another bump passing the 300m. He was favourite there, so the market expected a performance, and natural improvement second-up gives him a strong winning case. BALMAIN WARRIOR (5) has to rebound from a plain Hawkesbury effort, but provincial form, first-time blinkers and weight relief keep him in the wider winning mix. Gets a soft lead and can bounce back. INTERLOCKING (9) was only beaten two lengths on debut in the same Nowra race as ETERNAL TORMENT and has upside, with the $550,000 yearling purchase entitled to progress from that first look. GREY BELIEF (8) comes up with a slightly better gate today after he closed off from the rear to run fourth at Warren last start over 1400m. Ready for the trip and worth serious thought.
